summary: Proof-worth ownership for the AOS sovereign capability target and ADR 0044 amendment, accepted owner/control boundaries, bounded Milestone 2 current-truth burn-down, maintained-design doctrine scanning, machine topology, and preservation boundary.

entries.contract: ADR 0043 plus accepted ADR 0044; immediate socket-peer audit-token/PID-generation evidence; nearest mechanically verified non-AOS ancestry using proc-generation, UID, stable-edge, and code-identity evidence; discriminated daemon spawn evidence plus invocation-scoped parent-only intent, dynamic trusted signed-Node child admission, exact reviewed in-memory module bytes, tokenless peer finalization, and bounded cleanup of unfinalized prepared claims; attribution-only asserted lineage; live per-request same-effective-UID host control over the exact registered operation-plane set at one adapter-registry revision; daemon/status-host break-glass through the same public entrypoint; M2 daemon IPC, CLI, internal status, and internal Canvas projections with public SDKs deferred to M6; split all-or-nothing claim-set admission with exact multiplex broker/subscriber CAS and publication facts; exact-generation resource claims; persisted artifact custody and claim transaction recovery dispositions; generation-independent retained receipt replay with bounded eviction and expected-barrier CAS; explicit prior-generation recovery across nine target machines; schema-backed authority map; human ledger; generated ownership; unique scope/domain topology; local path integrity; path-specific required markers present in both the declared baseline revision and current worktree; a git-tracked active and generated authority doctrine scan including maintained design docs and the tracked rejection of a human-intent host-control class; exact baseline equality for every unaffected capability-current row while allowing only the declared global-input-event-observation listen-route, microphone, native-status-item, and Canvas Milestone 2 burn-down at inventory revision 59074238c2c4c43051c7461a6e36487e8914f4a6; actual bytes and declared hashes for ADRs 0015, 0018, 0030, 0031, 0040, 0041, and 0043 plus the frozen external-command manifest v0 schema independently match baseline revision 7aada1cb4d7a046a2b99b1b24470115eefc82224, including rejection of coordinated body-plus-hash drift; and exact preserved, historical, and frozen exclusions stay mutually consistent.
entries.worth: This fails when fixed browser grammar, including the maintained Playwright consumer crosswalk, an AOS-local capture admission gate, or narrow status-only control escapes its classified path baseline; it also fails if an undeclared capability-current row drifts, any declared M2 burn-down row loses its exact executable-candidate facts, asserted lineage can expand ordinary control, an ancestor gains imaginary audit-token authority, external dispatch can bless a substituted executable/script/argv/dependency-set shape or persist raw dependency identity, host control becomes a durable role or presentation-origin privilege, registered-set receipts overclaim unadapted legacy capabilities, retained replay becomes unbounded or an evicted mutation bypasses expected-barrier CAS, status break-glass loses mechanical daemon/status-host identity, claim admission retains a partial set or publishes a stale broker set, rollback recovery becomes success, released or retained artifact custody collapses to removed, microphone capture preempts legacy voice output, or prior-generation records teleport to terminal. Baseline-revision comparison prevents a transition banner from satisfying old implementation evidence, exact historical design paths and fixture subtrees remain excluded, and baseline byte-plus-hash comparison protects all declared immutable ADR bodies through ADR 0043 plus the frozen external-command manifest v0 schema while runtime migration is still staged.
